content.text:
ui_dir: /app/ui
upload_dir: /data/upload
extract_dir: /data/extract

logging:
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG
  version: 1

message_queue:
  name: web-service
  host: redis
  port: 6379

server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8090

database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/web_service.db'
  options:
    pool_size: 10
    max_overflow: 20


upload_dir: /data/upload


# logging.config.dictConfig
logging:
  version: 1
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  log_dir: /data/logs
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG
  loggers:
    websockets.client:
      handlers:
        - stdout
      level: INFO
      propagate: false


server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8090

database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/asr-service.db'

message_queue:
  name: asr
  host: redis
  port: 6379


jobs:
  worker: 2

language_detector:
  fallback: de
  probability: 0.65
  supported:
    - de
    - fr
    - en

model_settings:
  default:
    align:
      align_model: null
      interpolate_method: nearest
      no_align: false
      return_char_alignments: null
    align_model: null
    asr:
      beam_size: 5
      compression_ratio_threshold: 2.4
      condition_on_previous_text: false
      initial_prompt: null
      length_penalty: 1.0
      log_prob_threshold: -1.0
      no_speech_threshold: 0.6
      patience: 1.0
      suppress_numerals: null
      suppress_tokens:
      - -1
      temperature: 0
      temperature_increment_on_fallback: 0.2
    batch_size: 8
    compute_type: int8
    device: cpu
    device_index: 0
    diarize:
      diarize: true
      model_path: /models/diarization.generated.yaml
      max_speakers: null
      min_speakers: null
    hf_token: null
    language: de
    model: large-v3
    model_dir: null
    model_variant: whisperx
    print_progress: true
    threads: 4
    vad:
      chunk_size: 30
      vad_offset: 0.363
      vad_onset: 0.5
    verbose: true
database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/fs-watcher.dev.db'

extract_dir: '/data/extract'

jobs:
  worker: 2

logging:
  version: 1
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  log_dir: /data/logs
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG

message_queue:
  name: fs-watcher-dev
  host: redis
  port: 6379

watching:
  - dir: '/mnt'
    only_files: true
    recursive: false
    formats:
      - txt
      - srt
    filter:
      - pattern: '\.mp3$'
        allow: true
      - pattern: '\.mp4$'
        allow: true
      - pattern: '\.avi$'
        allow: true
      - pattern: '\.wav$'
        allow: true
=== VERSION ===
2.4.0

observation.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && cat web-service.default.yml asr-service.cpu.default.yml fs-watcher.default.yml; echo "=== VERSION ==="; cat /workspace/VERSION
